constraints: The scope of this command is the current working session; only one event-handling method can be active at a time.
By default the event-handling method runs in a separate local process named '$Event Manager' if processName is omitted.
If processName is prefixed with a dollar sign ($), a local process is started (usually what you want).
Do not call commands that generate events from within the event-handling method, or it becomes very difficult to exit that method's execution.

sentinelValues.meaning: Stops intercepting events instead of installing a handler.

params.name: processName
params.description: Name of the process created for the event-handling method; defaults to '$Event Manager' if omitted.

overloadMerges.semanticRole: Installs eventMethod as the event-catching method run in a dedicated process (named by processName, or '$Event Manager' by default), or stops catching events if eventMethod is an empty string.
overloadMerges.note: Documented the eventMethod empty-string sentinel (stop intercepting) and the processName default process name, which autoparse left as bare Text params.
